- Validate input n (non-negative int). Initialize list seq of length n+1; set seq[0]=1 (for n=0 case), seq[1]=3 when n≥1, and fill even indices i with seq[i]=1 + i/2 using integer division since examples yield integers.
- For odd i≥3, compute seq[i] using recurrence seq[i] = seq[i-1] + seq[i-2] + seq[i+1], which depends on seq[i+1]; thus precompute even indices first in increasing order, then compute odd indices in increasing order using already-known neighbors.
- Return seq up to index n; handle small n cases explicitly (n=0 -> [1], n=1 -> [1,3], n=2 -> [1,3,2]) to avoid out-of-range access.
